scope_note: The flat source list includes one test-only management fixture because the validator classifies tests/ helpers as source; production import isolation is checked separately. Local Go/TLS and real coordinator protocol tests do not stand in for an OS credential provider. The Linux production CLI/Secret Service result is fetched from the exact successful client CI revision before verify can pass. Local Darwin Keychain and the active installed DSH are not used. Physical Win/Mac retest remains a separate user acceptance gate.

real_commands.command: npm run environment:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run format:check && npm run type-check
cd networking && go vet ./... && go test -json -race -count=1 ./internal/controlplane ./internal/helper ./internal/localrpc ./internal/core > ../.run/certificate-lifecycle/core-tests.jsonl

cd networking && test -f "${DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY:?explicit verified server binary required}" && go test -json -race -count=1 -run '^TestCertificateRealCoordinatorLifecycle$' ./integration > ../.run/certificate-lifecycle/local-real-coordinator.jsonl
npm run service:smoke && npm run visual:smoke && npm run build && npm run build:electron
gh run view "${DSHKER_CLIENT_CI_RUN_ID:?explicit client CI run required}" --repo ankye/dshker --json headSha,status,conclusion,url > .run/certificate-lifecycle/client-quality.json

node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; const ci=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".run/certificate-lifecycle/client-quality.json","utf8")); const revision=execFileSync("git",["rev-parse","HEAD"],{encoding:"utf8"}).trim(); if(ci.headSha!==revision||ci.status!=="completed"||ci.conclusion!=="success") throw Error("client CI identity or quality gate is not verified"); const events=fs.readFileSync(".run/certificate-lifecycle/linux-real-process.jsonl","utf8").trim().split("\n").map(JSON.parse); if(events.some(e=>e.Action==="fail"||e.Action==="skip")) throw Error("production certificate process has failure or skip"); for(const name of ["TestCertificateRealCoordinatorLifecycle","TestCertificateRealCoordinatorCLICredentialReadback"]) if(!events.some(e=>e.Action==="pass"&&e.Test===name)) throw Error("required certificate process did not pass: "+name); for(const p of ["out/main/index.cjs","out/preload/index.cjs","out/preload/workbench.cjs"]) {const body=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"); for(const marker of ["certificateFixture","certificateSecrets","newCertificateFixture","vitest","vi.mock"]) if(body.includes(marker)) throw Error("test support reached production bundle: "+marker);}'
